assets.name: PedestrianPathSoft
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a standalone StockWars 2D game ground asset, clean restrained illustrated RPG town style. Elevated RPG top-down world with screen-horizontal and screen-vertical ground axes, NOT isometric, NOT a perspective trapezoid. Warm cream limestone, muted taupe edging, soft simple shading and very subtle broad stone color variation. Match a cozy town with cream buildings and simplified green landscaping. User explicitly dislikes grid patterns and excessive detail: absolutely NO tile grid, NO brick joints, NO cobblestones, NO cracks, NO grainy noise, NO small decorative marks. Broad calm empty surface. Thin readable bevel/edge, ground flush, not a raised platform or floating object. True transparent background. No text, watermark, buildings, people, trees, benches, fountain or other props. Temporary visual asset, does not establish permanent project art rules. A single straight HORIZONTAL WALKABLE PEDESTRIAN PATH strip, landscape canvas roughly 3:1. Cream stone center, slim continuous taupe borders along TOP and BOTTOM only. The road extends exactly to LEFT and RIGHT canvas edges, uncapped, same colors and height at both ends so it can repeat horizontally without gaps. Transparent space above and below only. Not asphalt, no traffic markings. Completely unbroken surface.
